instruction: Configure Thunderbird so that it downloads entire emails, not just headers, for all folders by turning on offline synchronization.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling offline synchronization in Thunderbird to automatically download all message bodies. The evaluator checks that mail.server.default.autosync_offline_stores and mail.server.default.offline_download are both set to true in prefs.js. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function with vm_file getter.
metadata.similarity_to_original: high - same application, similar configuration complexity, similar number of settings to modify

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vm_file extracts the Thunderbird prefs.js file from VM and returns a file path
Metric logic is correct: check_thunderbird_prefs parses prefs.js using regex and validates preferences against expected rules

Complete instruction coverage: Both preferences (mail.server.default.autosync_offline_stores and mail.server.default.offline_download) are semantically correct for enabling offline synchronization and downloading message bodies
Postconfig is appropriate: Closes Thunderbird window to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk before verification, includes 0.5s sleep for file system sync
Expected values are correct: Both preferences should be set to true (boolean) with exact match comparison
Type compatibility is handled correctly: Metric checks for None case (line thunderbird.py:41-42) and returns 0.0 if file retrieval fails
Parameter handling is correct: Metric function uses 'rule' parameter (not 'expected') and correctly accesses rule.get('expect', {}) and rule.get('unexpect', {})
